news.title: Musk's public endorsement of a SpaceX–Tesla deal may delay talks, sources say
news.summary: Musk's disclosure of the merger talks rattled some insiders, who worry it could invite shareholder scrutiny and delay the process by several weeks; one person called it a "mess". Advisers have been hired, SpaceX approached Tesla in recent weeks, and structures under discussion include a SpaceX acquisition of Tesla or a merger under a new holding company, possibly all-stock.

news.title: SpaceX and Tesla slide premarket as up to 1.3B SpaceX shares unlock today
news.summary: SPCX traded about 3% lower and TSLA about 5% lower in early premarket trading Thursday, the day the largest lock-up tranche (up to 1.3B shares, 28% of the main lock-up pool) becomes free to sell; another 328M follow on Oct. 24 and the main lock-up ends Dec. 8.

news.title: SpaceX closes up 7.8% at $159.31 after its Q3 beat and merger talk
news.summary: Shares rose 7.79% on Wednesday on about 221M shares traded (intraday range $156.93–$166.18) after a $4.4B quarterly profit, with the Super Intelligence segment more than half of revenue. Space ETFs and Rocket Lab rose with it; QQQ gained 1.1%.

news.title: Analysts lift SpaceX targets after Q3: JPMorgan to $500, Barclays $300, Wells Fargo $274
news.summary: JPMorgan raised its target to $500 from $240, Barclays to $300 from $254, Wells Fargo to $274 from $214, Citi to $240 from $200 and UBS to $230 from $210; Morgan Stanley kept $300 and HSBC stayed at Hold with a $150 target. Consumer Starlink subscribers rose 1.6M to 13.6M in the quarter.

news.title: SpaceX reports Q3 2026: revenue $14.6B (+161%), first profit as a public company
news.summary: Revenue rose 161% to $14.6B from $5.6B, with income from operations of $2.8B, net income of $4.4B (vs a $1.1B loss a year earlier) and adjusted EBITDA of $8.8B (+306%). Connectivity revenue grew 69%; nameplate compute reached 1.7 GW at Sept. 30, and the first revenue-generating Starship mission delivered 26 Starlink V3 satellites.

news.title: SpaceX jumps about 8% after hours on a revenue beat and a $33B–$37B Q1 2027 revenue guide
news.summary: Revenue of $14.58B beat the $12.72B LSEG consensus and adjusted EPS was 45 cents vs 13 cents expected; the AI business grew ninefold. CFO Bret Johnsen guided Q1 2027 revenue to $33B–$37B vs a $22.2B average estimate, citing visibility into the compute contract pipeline. Shares closed the regular session at $147.79.

news.title: Musk says a SpaceX-Tesla merger is 'a good idea' as both boards form special committees
news.summary: On the earnings call Musk confirmed for the first time that independent special committees at both companies are discussing a combination, but said no terms have been agreed and a deal may never happen. He also forecast $500B–$1T of annual recurring revenue by end-2027, and said the Terafab chip JV should produce a first test chip around May–June 2027.

news.title: AI revenue tops Starlink for the first time; up to 1.3B SpaceX shares unlock Thursday
news.summary: The Super Intelligence segment brought in $7.56B (helped by the Cursor acquisition) vs $5.25B for Starlink connectivity and $1.77B for launch. Capex of about $19.6B, mostly AI infrastructure, left free cash flow negative. Up to 1.3B shares become freely tradable on Thursday, Oct. 22, with another 328M on Oct. 24.

news.title: Earnings preview: AI spending and financing are the big questions as SpaceX reports Tuesday
news.summary: Bloomberg consensus calls for Q3 revenue of $12.7B (vs. $7.8B in Q2), adjusted EPS of $0.15 and adjusted EBITDA of $6.59B, with Connectivity (Starlink) expected at $4.45B revenue and $1.66B operating profit. Morgan Stanley's Adam Jonas called the need for more financing 'the biggest risk to our model', modeling $60B, $80B and $90B of debt issuance in 2027–2029; CFO Bret Johnsen said last month SpaceX would reach $100B of annual recurring revenue by year-end.

news.title: Musk says he'll give one of his SpaceX shares to every U.S. child next year
news.summary: Musk posted on X Monday that he will give each American child one of his SpaceX shares next year, calling it 'the first of many', without saying how it would work. With about 72 million U.S. children, CNBC put the giveaway at roughly $10.5B at Friday's $146.03 close; Musk owned about 4.8 billion shares per an August filing.

news.title: SpaceX and Tesla earnings this week will test Musk's AI spending as merger talk grows
news.summary: SpaceX reports Q3 after the close Tuesday, its second report as a public company; LSEG consensus is about $12.74B revenue and EPS of $0.14, versus Q2's $7.8B revenue, $541M net loss and $15.8B of AI capex. Barclays suggested last week a SpaceX–Tesla deal could come before Tesla's Dec. 3 annual meeting, with SpaceX the likelier acquirer; neither company has committed to one.

news.title: SpaceX will post Q3 2026 results after the close on Tuesday, Oct. 20
news.summary: SpaceX said it will release third-quarter financial and operational results after market close on Oct. 20 and host a live audio-only webcast at 3:30 p.m. CT / 4:30 p.m. ET, also streamed on X @SpaceX; investors can submit questions in advance.
